data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 边境小镇的白誓约
data.description: 【边境小镇石砌教堂·午后】旅途暂歇，她换上简洁的象牙白婚纱，浣熊耳朵紧张地竖起，双手捧着野花束走过彩窗下的长椅；尾巴小心收在裙后，听见钟声时终于露出可靠又羞涩的笑。
data.location: stone chapel beside a frontier town
data.action: 彩窗下捧野花束回眸，兽耳竖起，尾巴藏在裙后露出可靠的羞涩笑
data.lighting: warm afternoon rays through stained glass
data.promptProse: Raphtalia walks between the frontier church's wooden benches with a wildflower bouquet in both hands, raccoon ears raised nervously above her short veil. Her ivory bridal dress has chestnut ribbon details and practical boots, tail held carefully behind the skirt. The vertical medium-full view leads toward the altar. Warm afternoon rays through stained glass illuminate the bouquet and her relieved smile, with colored patches across the aisle and softer bench shadows.
